name: io.github.yarenty/emperor-folder
title: emperor-folder
description: List, read, search and (opt-in) write, edit and move files inside one folder, never outside it.

packageArguments.name: --root
packageArguments.description: The folder the server is confined to. Repeat for several roots; NAME=DIR names one.
Switch: also offer the write, edit and move tools (default: read-only). FOLDER_WRITABLE=true does the same.

environmentVariables.name: FOLDER_WRITABLE
environmentVariables.description: true, 1 or yes also offers the write, edit and move tools; unset, empty, false, 0 or no keep the server read-only.
